persistentCache: fresh isolated database per arm, retained; drain writes at settle
policy: A fixed 5000 ms stabilization precedes every pre/post idle control in both arms; retain those samples separately, never wait until healthy. Stop whole cohort on failed idle control, loss of foreground, runtime/integrity error or memory-cap violation; retain all arms; no selective retries.

decision.scope: Same-code 768/1536 MiB two-pair pilot; primary outcome revisit afterInputMs, secondary return and first transition. Not proof of a universal speedup or peak per-tab RSS.
decision.memoryScope: Sample scheduler bytes and engine logical GPU bytes; external Chrome process aggregate is contextual, not per-tab ownership. Complete process peak qualification may remain pending.
